description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from them, blinking a permanent you own.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from them, blinking Spark Double and choosing to have it enter as a non-legendary copy of Aminatou.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking a permanent you own.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Repeat.

uses.name: Aminatou, the Fateshifter
uses.cardState: with three or more loyalty counters
